shes pa yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhinamanya rab tu mkhyen ce na/ khyim bdag 'di la de bzhin gshegs pas 'di ltar rab tu mkhyen te/ sems can dpag tu med pa rnams kyi don byas shing don ma yin pa bzlog la/ snang ba byas shing mun pa bsal te/ sems can dpag tu med pa rnams sdug bsngal las yongs su thar bar byas nas/ bde ba la btsud pa ni thams cad mkhyen pa shes pa 'gog pa ste/de yang gzod ma nas ma na skyes pa'i chos can no/ /khyim bdag ji lde)ltar na de bzhin gshegs pas thams cad mkhyen pa shes pa 'gog pa shes pa yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin rab tu mkhyen to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mkhyen pa shes pa 'gog pa shes pa de la yang zhu ba zhus pa na/ bskal param kyilan gsung ba nas / de bzhin du sbyar te/ longs spyod pa'i bar du 'gyur ro/ /khyim bdag ji ltar na de bzhin gshegs pas thams cad mkhyen pa shes pa 'gog par 'gyur ba'i lam shes pa yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin rab tu mkhyen ce na/ khyim bdage 'di la de bzhin gshegs pas 'di ltar rab tu mkhyen te/ shes pa gang gis thams cad mkhyen pa shes pa yongs su shes/ khong du chud/ mngon sum du byas pa'i 'gog pa gal te ro myang ba med par rjes su lta bar gnas pa'am/ gal te nyes dmigs su rjes su lta bar gnas pa'am/ gal te nges par 'byung bar rjes su lta bar gnas pa de de bzhin gshegs pas yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin rab tu mkhyen to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mkhyen pa shes pa 'gog par 'gyur ba'i lam shes pa de la yang zhu ba zhus pa na/ bskal par lan gsung ba nas/bskal pa brgya'am/ bskal pa stong ngam/ bskal pa khri'am/ bskal pa bye ba'am / bskal pa ther 'bum 'amar/ bskal pa gtams sam/ bskal pa 47—222

dkrigs sam/ bskal pa yid yal tam1ri/ bskal pa khyad phyin tam ci/ bskal pa dpag tu med par lan gsung ngo / /bskal pa grangs med pa dang / bskal pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / gzhal du med pa dang / gzhal gyis mi lang bar lan gsung ngo / /bskal pa brjod du med par lan gsung ngo / /bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i yang dpag tu med par lan gsung ste/ bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i grangs med pa dang / dpag tu med pa'i bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang /dpag tu med pa'i gzhal du med pa dang / dpag tu med pa'i gzhal gyis mi lang ba dang / dpag tu med pa'i yang brjod du med par lan gsung ngo / /bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i grangs med pa dang / grangs med pa'i grangs med pa dang / grangs med pa'i bsam gyis (mi khyab pa dang / grangs med pa'i gzhal du med pa dang / grangs med pa'i gzhal gyis mi lang ba dang / grangs med pa'i brjod du med pa dang / bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i grangs med pa dang / bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gzhal du med pa dang / bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gzhal gyis ⑤mi lang ba dang / bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i brjod /6)du med pa dang /gzhal du med pa'i dpag tu med pa dang / gzhal du med pa'i grangs med pa dang ske/ gzhal du med pa'i bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / gzhal du med pa'i gzhal du med pa dang / gzhal du med pa'i gzhal gyis mi lang ba dang /gzhal du med pa'i brjod du med pa dang / gzhal gyis tsho mi lang ba'i dpag tu med pa dang / gzhal gyis mi lang ba'i grangs med pa dang / gzhal gyis mi lang ba'i bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / gzhal gyis mi lang ba'i gzhal du med pa dang zha gzhal gyis mi lang ba'i gzhal gyis mi lang ba dang / gzhal gyis 47—223

mi lang ba'i 1brjod du med pa dang / brjod du med pa'i dpag tu med pa dang /brjod du med pa'i grangs med pa dang / brjod du med pa'i bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / brjod du med pa'i gzhal du med pa dang / brjod du med pa'i gzhal gyis mi lang ba dang / brjod du med pa'i brjod du med par lan gsung ste / de'i spobs pa zad mi shes so/ /khyim bdag de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de bzhin gshegs pa des chos kyi dbyings bla na med pa/ mkhyen rab kyis shin tu thugs su chud de/ gang thugs su chud pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mkhyen pa shes pa 'gog par 'gyur ba'i lam shes pa de la yang zhu ba zhus pa na/bskal par lan gsung ste/ spobs pa mi zad do/ /de lta bas na 'dir gang gi ye shes mthong ba thogs pa med par 'jug pa de ni tsan dan gyi khyams dang khang bzangs kyi bar 'di la longs spyod par 'gyur ro/ /khyim bdag de la de bzhin gshegs pas gnas shes pa 'di ltar rab tu mkhyen te/ 'di lta ste dper na/nam mkha'i bya rjes ji snyed pa nyid ni 2ming tsam ste/ 5de bzhin gshegs pas gnas shes pa ji snyed pa nyid kyang ming tsam du de ltar rab tu mkhyen to/ /khyim bdag de la de bzhin gshegs pas gnas shes pa kun 'byung ba shes pa 'di ltar rab tu mkhyen te/ 'di lta ste dper na/ bud med gzhon nu dag gi rmi lam na bu btsas pa ji snyed pa nyid ni ming tsam ste/ de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pas gnas shes pa kun 'byung ba shes pa ji snyed pa nyid kyang ming tsam du de ltaram cirab tu mkhyen to/ /khyim bdag de la de bzhin gshegs pas gnas shes pa 'gog pa shes pa 'di ltar rab tu mkhyen te/ 'di lta ste dper na/ bud med gzhon nu dag gi rmi lam na bu shi ba 5ji snyed pa nyid ni ming tsam ste/ de bzhin du de 47—224

bzhin gshegs pas gnas shes pa 'gog pa shes pa ji snyed pa nyid kyang ming tsam du de ltar rab tu mkhyen to/ /khyim bdag de la de bzhin gshegs pas gnas shes pa 'gog par 'gyur ba'i lam shes pa 'di ltar rab tu mkhyen te/ 'di lta ste dper na/ bud med gzhon nu dag gi rmi lam na bu'i mya ngan byed pa ji snyed pa nyid ni ming tsam ste/ de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pas gnas shes pa 'gog par 'gyur ba'i lam shes pa ji snyed pa nyid kyang ming tsam du de ltar rab tu mkhyen to/ /khyim bdag de la de bzhin gshegs pas gnas ma yin pa shes pa 'di ltar rab tu mkhyen te/ 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' la ri mo bris pa ji snyed pa nyid ni ming tsam ste/ de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pas gnas ma yin pa shes pa ji snyed pa nyid kyang ming tsam du de ltar rab tu mkhyen to/ /khyim bdag de la de bzhin gshegs pas gnas ma yin pa shes pa kun 'byung ba shes pa 'di ltar rab tu mkhyen te/ 'di lta ste dper na/ rmi lam na tshon sbyor ba ji snyed pa nyid ni ming tsam ste/ khyim bdag de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pas gnas ma yin pa shes pa kun 'byung ba shes pa ji snyed pa nyid kyang ming tsam du de ltar rab tu mkhyen to1/ /khyim bdag de la de bzhin gshegs pas gnas ma yin pa shes pa 'gog pa shes pa 'di ltar rab tu mkhyen te/ 'di lta ste dper na/rmi lam na ri mo 'dri 5ba'i bye brag ji snyed pa nyid ni ming tsam ste/ de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pas gnas ma yin pa shes pa 'gog pa shes pa ji snyed pa nyid kyang ming tsam du de ltar rab tu mkhyen to/ /khyim bdag de la de bzhin gshegs pas gnas ma yin pa shes pa 'gog par 'gyur ba'i lam shes pa 'di ltar rab tu mkhyen te/ 'di lta ste dper na/ rmi lam na ri mo mkhan ji snyed pa nyid ni ming 47—225

skyes bu'i 1mi lam na rnam par sad pa byed pa shes pa ji snyed pa nyid ni ming tsam ste / de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pas rjes su 'jug pa shes pa ji snyed pa nyid kyang ming tsam du de ltar rab tu mkhyen to/ /khyim bdag de la de bzhin gshegs pas rjes su 'jug pa shes pa kun 'byung ba shes pa 'di ltar rab tu ri mkhyen te/'di lta ste dper na/ sgyu ma'i skyes bu'i rmi lam na rnam par sad pa shes pa ji snyed pa nyid ni ming tsam ste/ de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pas rjes su 'jug pa shes pa kun 'byung ba shes pa ji snyed pa nyid kyang ming tsam du de ltar rab tu mkhyen to/ /khyim bdag de la de bzhin gshegs pas rjes su 'jug pa shes pa 'gog pa shes pa 'di ltar rab tu mkhyen te/ 'di lta ste dper na/ sgyu ma'i skyes bu'i rmi lam na ma shi ba ji snyed pa nyid ni ming tsam ste/ de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pas rjes su 'jug pa shes pa 'gog pa shes pa ji snyed pa nyid kyang ming tsam du de ltar rab tu mkhyen to/ /khyim bdag de la de bzhin gshegs pas rjes su 'jug pa shes pa 'gog par 'gyur ba'i lam shes pa 'di ltar rab tu mkhyen te/ 'di lta ste dper na/ sgyu ma'i skyes bu'i rmi lam na mi 'thun pa'i rtsa ba yang dag par gcod pa ni ming tsam ste/ de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa nas de bzhin du sbyar te/ ming tsam gyi bar du'o/ /khyim bdag de la de bzhin gshegs pas yongs su mi nyams pa shes pa 'di ltar rab tu mkhyen te/ 'di lta ste dper na/ sgyu ma'i skyes bu'i rmi lam na dug 'thungs pa'i rtsi sman ma lus par byed pa ji snyed pa nyid ni ming tsam ste/ de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pas yongs su mi nyams pa shes pa ji snyed pa nyid kyang ming tsam du de ltar rab tu mkhyen to/ /khyim bdag de la de bzhin gshegs pas yongs su mi nyams pa shes 47—266

pa kun 'byung ba shes pa 'di ltar rab tu mkhyen te/ 'di lta ste dper na/ sgyu ma'i skyes bu'i rmi lam na dug byin pa la dug bsal 1ba tshol ba ji snyed pa nyid ni ming tsam ste/ de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pas yongs su mi nyams pa shes pa kun 'byung ba shes pa ji snyed pa nyid kyang ming tsam du de ltar rab tu mkhyen to/ /khyim bdag de la de bzhin gshegs pas yongs su mi nyams pa shes pa 'gog pa shes pa 'di ltar rab tu mkhyen te / 'di lta ste dper na/ sgyu ma'i skyes bu'i rmi lam na dug yang mi 'byung ba ji snyed pa nyid ni ming tsam ste/ de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pas yongs su mi nyams pa shes pa 'gog pa shes pa ji snyed pa nyid kyang ming tsam du de ltar rab tu mkhyen to/ /khyim bdag de la de bzhin gshegs pas yongs su mi nyams pa shes pa 'gog pa shes dpar 'gyur ba'i lam shes pa 'di ltar rab tu mkhyen te/ 'di lta ste dper na/ sgyu ma'i skyes bu'i rmi lam na dug byin pa la yang dag pa'i )gso ba'i dpyad byed pa ji snyed pa nyid ni ming tsam ste / de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pas yongs su mi nyams pa shes pa 'gog par 'gyur ba'i lam shes pa ji snyed pa nyid kyang ming tsam du de ltar rab tu mkhyen to/ /khyim bdag de la de bzhin gshegs pas thams cad mkhyen pa shes pa 'di ltar rab tu mkhyen te/ 'di lta ste dper na/ sgyu ma'i skyes bu'imatsharmi lam na rtsi sman mkhan nadam la mkhas pa dang / nad kun nas ldang ba la mkhas pa dang / nad pa'i khams la mkhas pa dang / sman sbyor 7ba la mkhas pa dang /kha zas kyi cho ga la mkhas pa dang / khrus kyi cho ga la mkhas pa dang / bsku587mnye'i cho ga la mkhas pa dang / rkang pas 9mnye ba'i cho ga la mkhas pa dang /lag pas mnye ba'i cho ga la mkhas pa dang / nyal ba'i cho ga la mkhas pa dang /47—267

sad pa'i cho ga la mkhas pa dang / longs spyod kun gyi53)cho ga la mkhas pa dang /dpyad kyi sbyor ba 'jug na pa la mkhas pa dang / dus shes/ tshod shes/ dus min shes shing sgyu ma'i skyes bu'i rmi lam na gertsi sman dag gis nad thams cad 'joms pa shes pa ji snyed pa nyid ni ming tsam ste/ de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pas thams cad mkhyen pa shes pa ji snyed pa nyid kyang ming tsam du de ltar rab tu mkhyen to/ /khyim bdag de la de bzhin gshegs pas thams cad mkhyen pa shes pa kun 'byung ba shes pa 'di ltar rab tu mkhyen te/ 'di lta ste dper na/sgyu ma'i skyes bu'i rmi lam na sprul pa'i gso ba'i dpyad shes pa ji snyed pa nyid ni ming tsam ste/ de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pas thams cad mkhyen pa shes pa kun 'byung ba shes pa ji snyed pa nyid kyang ming tsam du de ltar rab tu mkhyen to/ /khyim bdag de la de bzhin gshegs pas thams cad mkhyen pa shes pa 'gog pa shes pa 'di ltar rab tu mkhyen te/ 'di lta ste dper na/ sgyu ma'i skyes bu'i rmi lam na nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed pa shes pa ji snyed pa nyid ni ming tsam ste / de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pas thams cad mkhyen pa shes pa 'gog pa shes pa ji snyed pa nyid kyang ming tsam du de ④ltar rab tu mkhyen to/ /khyim bdag de la de bzhin gshegs pas thams cad mkhyen pa shes pa 'gog par 'gyur ba'i5nasalam shes pa 'di ltar rab tu mkhyen te/ 'di lta ste dper na/ sgyu ma'i skyes bu'i rmi lam na gso ba'i dpyad ji snyed pa nyid ni ming tsam ste/ de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pas thams cad mkhyen pa shes pa 'gog par 'gyur ba'i lam shes pa ji snyed pa nyid kyang ming tsam du de ltar rab tu mkhyen to/ /khyim bdag de lta bas na 'dir gang gi ye shes mthong ba thogs pa med par 'jug pa gzhan gyis ma 47—268

bstan cing / gzhan la rag ma las pa'i shes pas sems can rnams la phan gdags7)pa'i don du bdag nyid mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa de ni tsan dan gyi khyams dang / khang bzangs kyi bar 'di la longs spyod par 'gyur ro/ /de skad ces smras pa dang / khyim bdag phywa mkhan gyis lag gi bla tshe dang ldan pa gang po la 'di skad ces smras so/ /gang po bcom ldan 'das de da7ltar gang na bzhugs / de skad ces smras pa dang / lag gi bla gang pos khyim bdag phywa mkhan la 'di skad ces smras so/ /khyim bdag byang phyogs logs na ko sa la zhes bya ba'i yul gyi ljongs yod de/ gangs ri'i rgyal po'i drung na mnyan yod ces bya ba grong khyer chen po de na rgyal po'i bu gzhon nu rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na/ bcom ldan 'das de da ltar bzhugs so/ /de skad ces smras pa dang / khyim bdag phywa mkhan gyis lag gi bla tshe dang ldan pa gang po la 'di skad ces smras so/ /gang po mnyan yod kyi grong khyer chen po 'di nas ring khyad ci tsam smras pa/ khyim bdag de dpag tshad sum stong drug cu rtsa bzhi yod do/ /de skad ces smras pa dang / khyim bdag phywa mkhan gyis selag gi bla tshe dang ldan pa gang po la 'di skad ces smras sokha/ /gang po ring ba de nas bcom ldan 'das de ji gasrid cig gis 'dir byon smras pa/khyim bdag de bzhin gshegs pa la ni ring ba'am nye ba med de/ khyim bdag bcom ldan 'das de bzhed na/ sems can yongs su smin par bya ba'i phyir grangs med pa'i gang gā'i 4)klung gi bye ma snyed las lhag pa'i 'jig rten gyi ⑦khams khrag khrig dag tu gshegs so/ /khyim bdag 'di sel de bzhin gshegs pas sems can thams cad kyi sems dang spyod pa dag mkhyen/ shin tu mkhyen/47—269

shin tu gzigs/ shin tu thugs su chud/ shin tu mngon sum du mdzad de/mig btsums pa tsam gyis sems can thams cad kyi sems dang spyod pa dag rab tu mkhyen to/ /khyim bdag de bzhin gshegs pas de bzhed na sems can thams cad la phan gdags pa'i blo nye bar bzhag nas/ 'jig rten gyi khams khrag khrig dag tu gshegs so/ /gang po bdag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su gzung ba'i phyir de bzhin gshegs pa de zhal zas bzang po la nye bar spyan drangs na gshegs sam/khyim bdag gal te cung zad yongs su gtong ba lta na de bzhin gshegs pa de zhal zas gtsang ma la spyan drongs shig dang / khyod kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su gzung ba'i phyir bcom ldan 'das de nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas par gshegs so / /de nas khyim bdag phywa mkhan gyis 1)tshe dang ldan pa gang po'i ltar mnyan nas / me tog dang / phreng ba dang / bdug pa dag blangs te/ tsan dan gyi khyams dang / khang tshonabazangs kyi steng du 'dzegs nas me tog gis brgyanami/spos kyis byugs nas/ bcom ldan 'das de phyogs gang logs na bzhugs pa der 5phyogs nas gos phrag pa gcig 6)tu gzar te/ pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs 7rinas thal mo sbyar te 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag la thugs brtse 8ba nye bar dgongs te/ zhal zas bzang po detshatshel de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dge slong gi dge 'dun dang thabs cig 1 tu gshegs par ci gnang / bcom ldan 'das rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal na bzhugs pa/ mi las 'das pa/ lha'i snyan rnam par dag pas /1khams kyi 1 khyim bdag phywa lha mkhan gyis kyi spyan drangs pa gsan nas gshegs par gnang ngo / /de nas khyim bdag phywa skomakhan gyisamatshabacom ldan 47—270

'das mngon par spyan drangs te/ bran dang / las byed pa dang / zho shas 1'tsho ba dang / mdza' bshes dang / nye du dang / snag gi gnyen mtshams dag la 'di skad ces smras so/ /khyed cag nyon cig ngas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas par zhal zas bzang po la spyan drangs kyis(2/ de la khyed nus pa ci yod pa dang / mthu ci yod pa'i lus kyis zhal ta bya ba la brtson pa dang ldan par gyis shig /khyim bdag phywa /mkhan gyis de skad ces smras pa dang /mdza' bshes dang / nye du dang / snag gi gnyen mtshams dang / bran 4pho dang ske/ bran mo dang / las byed pa dang / zho shas 'tsho ba dag gis khyim bdag phywa 5tshomakhan la 'di skad ces smras so/ /khyim bdag smyos so/ /khyim bdag g.yengs so/ /gang bcom ldan 'das de ma mthong bar zhal zas bzang po la spyan 'dren tam/ khyim bdag phywa mkhan gyis bcom ldan 'das de spyan 'dren to zhes su tsigasol/ de skad ces smras pa dang / khyim bdag phywa 7rimakhan gyis mdza' bshes dang / blon po dang / nye du dang / snag gi gnyen mtshams dang ske/ bran pho dang / bran mo dang / las byed pa dang / zho shas na'atsho ba dag la 'di skad ces smras so/ /grogs po dag bcom ldan 'das de sangs rgyas kyi yon tan dpag tu med pa dag brnyes te/ des na 9nga'i sems mkhyen nas gnang ngo / /de dag mgu zhing dga' la yi 1 rangs pa dang / rab tu dga' zhing bde ba dang / yid bde ba skyes nas de'i mtshan mo bza' ba dang /bca' ba bzang zhing rab tu mang po mngon par yang dag par 11byas so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de phyem red kyi dus su nang du yang dag 'jog las 47—271

bzhengs nas/ rtsig ma'i ldum bu'i 'khor gyi73)khyams ga la ba der gshegs so/ /de'i tshe rtsig ma'i ldum bu'i 'khor gyi khyams na/ tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo dang ske/ dge slong rab tu mang po dag dang lhan cig tu na/'dus nas 'khod par gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo song la mnyan yod kyi grong khyer chen po na dge slong nye bar gnas shing 'khod pa ji snyed pa de dag thams cad rim gro'i (9gnas su 'dus canas nga la sgron cig /tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos de ltar 'tshal zhes bcom ldan 'das kyi ltar mnyan nas/ mnyan yod kyi grong khyer chen po na dge slong nye bar gnas shing 'khod pa ji snyed pa de dag thams cad rim gro'i rigaganas su 'dus phyinas/ bcom ldan 'das ga la bzhugs pa der song ste 3)phyin nas / bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod kyi grong khyer chen po na dge slong nye bar gnas shing mchis pa de dag thams cad rim gro'i gnas su 'dus lags te/ bcom ldan 'das de'i dus la dbab lags so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rim gro'i 8)gnas ga la ba der gshegs nas gdan bcas pa de la bzhugs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong de dag la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag (9)grong khyer chen po dge ba'i pha rol 'gro na/khyim bdag phywa 1 mkhan gyis sangs rgyas dang dge slong gis/rkedage 'dun la sogs pa mngon par spyan drangs te/ de ngas gnang gis71shede'i phyir dge slong gang dag rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pa de dag gis tshul shing long72shig /de'i tshe na derasnyadage slong lnga brgya'i tshadage slong gi dge 'dun gang dag gis tshul shing blangs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshadage slong dag la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag rdzu 47—272

'phrul gyi 'phrul ba rnam pa sna tshogs dag gis sems can dag yang dag par dga' bar bya ba'i phyir/ nam mkha'i lam 91tsholas 'dong bar gyis (5 shig /bcom ldan 'das legs so zhes gsol te/ dge slong de dag bcom ldan 'das kyi ltar mnyan to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de'i mtshan mo 'das nas nang par sngar smad g.yogs dang / chos gos gsol/ lhung bzed bsnams te rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal nas nam mkha' la mngon par 'phags te/ grong khyer chen po dge ba'i pha rol 'gro ga la ba der gshegs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa shing shun can rgyal po'i khab na drang srong gi ri ngos la sba dang / shing pib (4pa la skye ba na 'dug la/ nam gyi cha stod 95dang cha smad la mi nyal bar rnal 'byor la brtson te / byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun dag bsgom 6pa'i rnal 'byor la rjes su brtson zhing / zhi gnas dang lhag mthong la mngon par brtson pa 'chag cing 'gro ba des bcom ldan 'das nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang thabs cig (3)tu nam mkha'i lam nas gshegs pa mthong ste/ 'di lta ste dper na/ngang pa'i rgyal po ltar mthong nas/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas/ bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal zhing 'dug go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 8tshe dang ldan pa shing shun can la bka' stsal pa/shing shun can tshur shog /de nas tshe dang ldan pa shing shun can bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal par rig nas/ lus dang srog la ma bltas par ngam grog dang g.yang sa de la bdag nyid mchongs so/ /de bar snang la song ma thag tu mngon par shes pa drug mngon sum du byas par gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das dang / shing shun can dang / dgra bcom pa lnga brgya tshang bar thabs 47—273

cig 1tu grong khyer chen po dge ba'i pha rol 'gro ga la ba der gshegs so/ /de nas dge slong de dag rdzu 'phrul gyi 'phrul pa rnam pa sna tshogs dag gis tsan dan gyi khyams dang / khang bzangs der mngon par zhugs te/ la la ni seng ge'i gzugs / la la ni stag gi gzugs/ la la ni glang po che'i gzugs/ la la ni rta'i gzugs/ la la ni khyu mchog gi gzugs/ la la ni klu'i gzugs/ la la ni nam mkha' lding gi rgyal po'i gzugs/ la la ni 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po'i gzugs/ la la ni blon po'i gzugs/ la la ni dge slong rang gi gzugs/la la ni lus las 'od sngon po dag rab tu 'byin/ la la ni dmar po dang /la la ni dkar po dang / la la ni lus las 'od btsod kha dag rab tu 'byin/la la ni char 'bebs/ la la ni rlung rab tu gtong / la la ni nor gyi char rab tu 'bebs/ la la ni gser gyi char rab tu 'bebs/ la la ni dngul gyi char rab tu 'bebs/ la la ni spos chu'i char rab tu 'bebs/ la la ni ser bu bsil ba rab tu gtong / la la ni phrag pa sa la na khyer/ la la ni rgya mtsho chen por chu 'bebs pa khyer / la la ni shing rta la zhon/ la la ni glang po che'i shing rta la zhon/ la la ni rta'i shing rta la zhon/ la las 47ni klu'i shing rta mngon par sprul/ la las ni grul bum gyi shing rta mngon par sprul/ la las ni gnod sbyin gyi shing rta mngon par sprul/ la las ni dri za'i shing rta mngon par sprul/la las ni cho 'phrul dag zung du sprul/ la las ni bdag 5lus las me 'bar /la las ni bdag gi lus las chu 'dzag ste/ de dag la sogs pa rdzu 7'phrul gyi 'phrul pa rnam pa sna tshogs gzhan dag gis kyang tsan dan gyi khyams dang / khang bzangs su mngon par zhugs so/ /bcom ldan 'das ni bdag nyid kyi dngos po 47—274

bzung bas skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis ni yang dag par brgyan/dpe 1)byad bzang po brgyad cus ni rnam par spras/ mdzes shing dang ba dang /dbang po ni zhi/ thugs ni zhi/ dul ba dang / zhi gnas dam pa ni brnyes/dul ba dang / zhi gnas mchog gi pha rol tu nisngonasaphyin/ mi mjed55)kyi bdag po tshangs pa dang / lha'i dbang po brgya byin dang / rgyal po chen po bzhi dang /gnas gtsang ma'i ris kyi lha'i bu stong dag gis ni phyag byas/ bdud rtsi'i char gyi rgyun rab tu 'bebs shing mchod pa dang / me tog man dā ra ba'i char 'bebs shing / tsan dan gyi khyams dang khang bzangs su 4)mngon par gshegs te / de lta bas na/ bcom ldan 'das nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang thabs cig 5tu sems can dag yang dag par dga' bar mdzad cing / tsan dan gyi khyams dang khang bzangs sum )mngon par gshegs so/ /dge ba'i pha rol 'gro'i 75bram ze dang / khyim bdag gis bcom ldan 'das nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang thabs cigasho)tu bar snang las gshegs pa mthong ste/ 'di lta ste dper na/ ngang pa'i rgyal po chen po lta bur mthong nas/ srog chags khri dag chos rnams la chos kyi mig rdul med cing dri ma dang bral te rnam par dag go/ /gang dag sngon gyi sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la spyad pa'i srog chags khri dag gis ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyi rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul mthong nas/ byang chub tu sems bskyed de/de dag byang chub tu sems bskyed ma thag tu mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob bo/ /sngon sems ma bskyed pa'i srog chags khri dag gis ni byang chub tu sems bskyed do//nyan thos dag gis 'dul ba'i srog chags brgyad khri dag ni nyan thos kyi rdzu 'phrul mthong nas chos rnams la chos kyi mig rdul med cing dri ma dang bral te rnam par 47—275

dag go/ /lha'i bu khri dag gis ni bcom ldan 'das kyi rdzu 'phrul mthong nas/chos rnams la chos kyi mig rdul med cing dri ma dang bral te rnam par dag go/ /gzugs na spyod pa'i lha'i bu khri dag gis ni/ chos rnams la chos kyi mig rdul med cing dri ma dang bral te rnam par dag pa nas/ phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu thob pa'i bar du gyur to/ /de nas lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin gyis dri za'i rgyal po'i bu gtsug phud 1lnga pa la smras pa/ gtsug phud 0lnga pa de bzhin gshegs pa la bkur sti gyis shig /dri za'i rgyal po'i bu gtsug phud gelnga pas de ltar 'tshal lo 5zhes lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin gyi ltar mnyan te/ dri za sa ya phrag drug dag 6dang lhan cig 47)tu rgyud kyi dbyangs dang / glu'i di 8)dbyangs kyis de bzhin gshegs pa la bkur tshoste byed do/ /rol mo'i sgra dang glu sgra de dag gis rgya mtsho chen po'i klu'i 1 tshorgyal po de hu1dag rab tu dga' zhing bde ba dang yid bde ba skyes nas rang rang gi gnas nas byung ngo / /de dag byung bas rgya mtsho chen po na 'byung po chen po dag gi nyu2gnas rnam par 'khrugs so/ /klu'i rgyal po mdzes pa la sogs pa klu dung phyur phrag brgyad snyedag bcom ldan 'das la blta ba'i phyir rgya mtsho chen po nas bskyod do/ /klu'i rgyal po lha mdzes la sogs pa klu dung phyur phrag dgu dag bcom ldan 'das la skobalta ba dang / phyag bya ba dang / bsnyen bkur bya ba'i phyir bskyod do/ /klu'i rgyal po rgya mtsho la stsogs skupa klu dung phyur phrag dgu dag bcom ldan 'das blta ba'i phyir rgya mtsho chen po nas bskyod do/ /klu'i rgyal po gser gtsug la sogs pa klu dung phyur phrag dgu dag bcom ldan 'das blta ba'i phyir bskyod do/ /klu'i rgyal po ud pa la mig la sogs pa klu dung phyur phrag dgu dag bcom ldan 'das blta ba'i phyir bskyod do/ /klu'i rgyal po 47—276

dga' bo la sogs pa klu dung phyur phrag dgu nas/ de bzhin du sbyar te thams cad la yang bya'o/ /klu'i rgyal po nye dga' la sogs pa klu dung phyur phrag dgu dang ske/ klu'i rgyal po ma dros pa la sogs pa klu dung phyur phrag dgu dang / klu'i rgyal po e la'i0)rā ba ṇa la stsogs 5pa klu dung phyur phrag dgu dang / klu'i rgyal po tshib pa'i bu la sogs riXpa klu dung phyur phrag dgu dang / klu'i rgyal po mig canag pa la sogs pa klu dung phyur phrag dgu dang / klu'i rgyal po gau ta ma la sogs pa klu dung phyur phrag dgu dang / klu'i rgyal po kum pa la la nosogs pa klu dung phyur phrag dgu dang / klu'i rgyal po yul 'khor srung la sogs pa klu dung phyur phrag dgu dang / klu'i rgyal po mgrin sngon la sogs pa klu dung phyur phrag dgu dang /klu'i rgyal po gser mgrin la sogs pa klu dung phyur phrag dgu dang / klu'i rgyal po 'jigs sgros56)la stsogs ltapa klu dung phyur phrag dgu dang / klu'i rgyal po gzi can la sogs pa klu dung phyur phrag dgu dang / klu'i rgyal po rnam par snang byed la sogs pa klu dung phyur phrag dgu dang / klu'i rgyal po rdul bral la stsogs 3)pa klu dung phyur phrag dgu nas/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ klu'i rgyal po 'od chen la sogs pa dang / klu'i rgyal po rab tu gdung byed la sogs pa dang / klu'i rgyal po stobs chen la sogs pa dang / klu'i rgyal po sprin chen la sogs pa dang /klu'i rgyal po zla chen la sogs pa klu dung phyur phrag dgu dang / rlung sheyang dag par ston pa la sogs pa klu dung phyur phrag dgu dang / klu'i rgyal po shugs 'dzin la sogs pa klu dung phyur phrag dgu dang / klu'i rgyal po sprin chen la sogs pa dang ske/ klu'i rgyal po rab tu gdul dka' la sogs pa dang / klu'i rgyal po thams cad me long zhes bya ba klu dung phyur phrag dgu dang / klu'i rgyal po char chen 47—277

spyod la sogs pa klu dung phyur phrag dgu dag 1kyi /bcom ldan 'das la blta ba'i phyir / rgya mtsho chen po nas bskyod do/ /de dag la sogs pa klu bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong dpag tu med pa gzhan dag dang / 'khor dung phyur phrag dgu dag bcom ldan 'das la blta ba'i phyir rgya mtsho chen po nasam bskyod do/ /de dag gis rgya mtsho chen po dkrugs so/ /dge slong de dag gis kyang grong khyer dang /grong rdal /dang / tshong 'dus cadang / ri 'or sa dang bcas pa dkrugasatshan so/ /de nas sa 6rnam pa du mar g.yos/ rab tu g.yos/ kun tu rab tu g.yos/'gul rab tu 'gul/ kun tu rab tu 'gul/ ldeg rab tu ldeg /kun tu rab tu ldeg go/ /de nas khyim bdag phywa mkhan gyis sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun la bza' ba dang / bca' ba dang 7tsho/ myang ba bzang zhing rab tu mang po rang gi lag gis 8yang dag par tshim par byas shing yang dag par brims so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/dge slong dag su'i bsod snyoms kyang yongs su bza' bar mi bya ste/ grong khyer chen po dge ba'i pha rol 'gro ba 'di klu dkrugs pa dag gis grong khyer ma rung bar byas sa 9re/ de nas bcom ldan 'das bsod snyoms bzhes nas nam mkha' la mngon par 'phags te/ 'di lta ste dper na/ ngang pa'i rgyal po chen po bzhin no/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong gi dge 'dun phyir bkye nas gnas su sprul pa brgya stong phrag dpag tu med pa dag mngon par sprul to/ /der klu'i rgyal po gang dag bcom ldan 'das blta bar 'dod pa de dag la de bzhin gshegs pa'i sprul pa mngon par sprul to/ /klu'i rgyal po gang dag bcom ldan 'das la ma dad cing blta bar mi 'dod pa de dag yongs su smin par bya 47—278

ba'i don du 'od zer bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag dpag tu med pa dag mngon par sprul to1)/ /der klu bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag dpag tu med pa dag mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob bo/ /klu bye ba khrag khrig dpag tu med pa dag ni sangs rgyas la dad pa skyesasheso/ /de dag dad pa thob ma thag tu klu'i skyedzaguganas de nas shi ste/ bde 'gro mtho ris kyi 'jig rten du skyes so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis klu bye ba khrag khrig dpag tu med pa de dag btul nas bsod snyoms bzhes te bar snang la gshegs so/ /de'i tshe na yul lag mthil ltar 4mnyam pa na dka' thub tshogacan mes byin zhes bya ba zhig gnas te ci/ de nas bcom ldan 'das nam mkha'i bar snang las gshegs pa mthong ngo / /de mthong nas kyang bcom ldan 'das la shin tu gus pa bskyed nas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag la mtshan ma'i rnam pa de bzhin du mdzad du gsol/ gang 7bdag gi gnas 'dir bzhugs na mchod par bgyi'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis ral pa can mes byin gyi bsam pa thugs su chud nas/ skye bo phyi ma dag nyid la thugs brtse ba'i slad du rdo leb la zhabs bzhag go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis naral pa can mes byin la 'di 9)skad ces bka' stsal to/ /bram ze khyod kyi sems dad par bya ba'i don du 'di ni mchod rten no/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa mod 3 gal gyi bu chen po la bka' stsal pa/ mod gal gyi bu tshur shog /ma dros pa'i mtsho ga la ba der 'dong ngo / /bcom ldan 'das legs so zhes gsol nas/tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po 11bcom ldan 'das kyi ltar mnyan nas/klu'i rgyal po ma dros pa'i gnas kyi chu 'gram du bzhugs so/ /de nas klu'i rgyal po 47—279

ma dros pa bcom ldan 'das nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa gshegs par rig nas/ gser dang / dngul dang / be+e drur+ya 0byedang / shel dang / mu tig dmar po dang / spug gi snying po dang / rdo'i snying po rin po che sna bdun las byas pa'i stan lnga brgya tsam zhig mngon par sprul to/ /khri stan ri lnga brgya de dag gi dbus su bcom ldan 'das kyi gdan rin po che sna bdun las byas pa'i gdan bshams te/ klu'i ras bcos bus g.yogs so/ /de nas klu'i rgyal po ma dros pa klu'i bu mo'i /'khor dang bcas pa bcom ldan 'das kyi57drung du song ngo //de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po zan zos shing lhung bzed dang lag pa bkrus ⑤par thugs su chud nas bka' stsal pa/mod gal gyi bu song la gnas brtan shā ri'itswabu khyod la ston pa ri 'bod do zhes smros shig /bcom ldan 'das legs so zhes gsol te/ tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po bcom ldan 'das kyi ltar mnyan nas/ 'di lta ste dper na/skyes bu stobs dang ldan pa'i lag pa bskum pa rkyong5nyeba'am/ brkyang ba skum7pa de bzhin du tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po ma dros pa'i mtsho nas byung ste/rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal na tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i 3 )bu'i mdun na 'dug go/ /de'i tshe na tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu snam sbyar 'brub 37par gyur to/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i 12bu dang lhan cig tu yang dag par dga' ba'i gtam dang gtam snyan pa rnam pa mang po byas nas/tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu la 'di skad ces smras so/ /ston pa ni tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu khyod la 'bod de/lha/ ston pa khyod la mngon par dgyes kyisabo/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i mabu tshur shog /ston pa khyod la gsung gis skya'adong ngo / /de 47—280

skad ces smras pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i0)bus tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po la 'di skad ces smras so/ /tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po re shig50snam sbyar 'di 'tshem mo/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen pos sor mo lnga khab lngar mngon par sprul nas snam sbyar de btsems so/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'im bus tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po la 'di skad ces smras so/ /tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu 'di ci byed smras pa/ snam sbyar btsem par bya ba 'di myur du btsem par bya'o/ /smras pa/ drub pa dang zin pa nyid du gyis shig /de ma thag tu drubs shingate zin pa nyid du byas nas/ smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'ir bu tshur shog da 'dong / smras pa/ mi 'gro'o61/ /smras pa/gal te khyed7mi 'gro na stobs kyis bkur ro/ /smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu re shig ska pa byerags 'di stobs kyis khyer nus dang nga stobs 1)kyis khyer bar shes so/ /des ska 3 rags de 'jig rten gyi khams bdun du byin gyis brlabs hu1so/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen pos ska 32rags de rdzu 'phrul gyi stobs kyis bteg pa na stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di g.yos kyang ska /snyerags de gdeg par ma nus so/ /de nas ma dros pa'i mtsho rlabs7shin tu g.yos so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa rta thul gyis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten du dog sa chen po g.yos pa byung ba 'di rgyu gang lags/ rkyen gang lags/ de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis rta thul la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /nyan thos chen po'i rnam par 'phrul pa'o/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i 8bus tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu la 'di skad ces smras so/ /tshe dang 47—281

ldan pa mod gal gyi bu je bzhud cig /bdag kyang mchi'o/ /de skad smras nas/tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu 1bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar song nas zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po ni phyi nas 'ong ngo / /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i rin bu mngon du phyogs pa'i rdzu 'phrul thob pas de dang por bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar song nas 'dug go//de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis mtshan ma de lta bu byung ba mdzad pa'i mtshan ma ji lta bu byung ba mdzad pas rgya mtsho'i klu'i rgyal po bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song nas phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la klu'i rgyal po mdzes dga'as 'di skad ces gsol to/ /gal te bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag la skabs phye na/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa la bdag phyogs 'ga' zhig zhu'o/ /bka' stsal pa/ mdzes dga' ngas zhu ba rilung bstan pa'i phyir 'di ltar thams cad skabs dbye bar bya'o/ /tshigs su bcad pa/ ston pa bde byin mdzad 5la zhu ba ni/ /spyad pa spyod tshe sug las ci bgyis dang / /bde ba'i lam gyis kyi mya ngan 'das reg pa/ /bde gshegs sbyin mdzad de ni lung bstan gsol/ /ma dros klu yi 7'jig rten mgon de la/ /zhus pa bde bar gshegs pas lung bstan pa/ /dge ba'i las kyi 'bras bus yid 'ong nazhing ske/ /gang gi bde bas bde bar gshegs pa bskyed/ /sngon gyi 9)srid par spyad pa spyod pa'i tshe/ /skye bo thams cad bde bas bde ldan byas/ /de 1 riyis legs pa'i las de byas pas na/ /bde ba'i lam gyis mya ngan 'das reg 'gyur//ston pa'i gsung gis mdzes pa de dga' nas/ /de yi skad cig sa steng pus btsugs 1 te/ /gzhal med dga' ba'i 12sems ni dang bas su/ /'jig rten 47—282

sgron ma 'dren la phyag 'tshal byed/ /ston pa'i blo yis mkhas la phyag 'tshal lo /'gro ba kun las nges 'byung 1 phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jigs med blo dag pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bde gshegs gzhan min gsung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas klu'i rgyal po lha mdzes kyis bcom ldan 'das la tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs kyis zhus pa/ 'od mdzad spyan sdug legs pa'i spyan mnga' ba/ /blo dge nyon mongs tshogs las rnam grol zhing / /ye shes dri med spyod yul khyod la ni/ /spyad pa spyod tshe rnam thar bla med zhu/ /lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten sman slad du/ /ji ltar spyad na byang chub zhi 'tshal zhing / /mi mchog dam pa bdag gi spyod sbyong ba②ske/ /yid 'das de dag bdag la bka' stsal gsol/ /rgyal ba de yis rdul bcom dbang po bsdams/ /'dod pa'i 'ching las thugs ni rnam 3grol ba'i/ /dgongs pa'i —de nyid sems kyi rjes 'jug pa/ /thugs zhi ma dkrugs des ni lung bstan pa/ /mkhas pas dge ba 5dag ni spyad pa'i phyir/ /srog gi phyir yang yid ni mi ldog cing / /rtag tu spyod tshe nyon mongs med yid kyis/ /lus dang ngag gis 96ridage ba mnyam spyod pa/ /de yis legs pa'i las de byas pas na//'khor ba'i 'gro la spyod pa 7)rnam dag ste/ /chu yi nang nas pad ma naskye ba ltar/ /gos pa med cing byang chub yang dag 'grub/ /bde gshegs gsung gis lha yi 9mdzes pa klu/ /de ni dga' zhing 1 legs par mgu 1 bas su/ /de yi skad cig sa la pus btsugs 12te/ /sangs rgyas rkang gnyis mchog la phyag 'tshal byed/ /thub pa 'jig rten gsum 1lhal sman mdzad pa/ /blo gros nges par zhi la phyag 'tshal lo/ / spyad pa saspyod tshe khyod kyi rjes slob 15cing / /byang chub mi g.yo layid ni bskyed par bgyi/ /sems can don du spyad pa spyod pa'i tshe/ /lus dang 47—283

srog ni de bzhin btang nas su/ /sdug bsngal thar byed sangs rgyas 'gyur ba dang ske/ /byang chub zhi ba bla med thob par bla)bgyi/ /klu de'i bsam pa thugs su chud nas su/ /rgyal ba nadagra las chosargyal ba 'dzum mdzad de/ /de tshe ji ltar gang gā'i bye snyed kyi/ /sangs rgyas mtha' yas zhing ni 'od kyis khyab/ /bde bar gshegs pas 'dzum pa bstan pa la/ /nam mkha'i lhas rig legs so zhes gsol te/ /e ma'o rgyal bas rdul bcom dbang po bsgoms/ /khyod dang mnyam med gong na yod ma yin/ /sangs rgyas zhing mang dag ni rab g.yos shing //'dod pa'i lha ni sder bcas shin tu rmongs/ /lha tshogs mang po bsam pa rab dga' zhing / /rgyal ba dbang po thub la phyag 'tshal byed/ /ston pa'i nyan thos rdzu 'phrul che ba'i mchog /mod gal bu yis ④rgyal la yongs zhus pa/ /gang gis dpag tu med pa'i 'dzum mdzad pa/ /bcom ldan bde gshegs rgyu gang rkyen gang lags/ /mod gal bu yis rgyal la nyer zhus pa/ /the tsom 5)gcod mdzad rgyal bas bka' stsal pa/ /nga la mchod pa byed pa'i klu 'di ni/ /ma 'ongs pa yi dus na sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /ji snyed zhing 'di 'od kyis khyab pa dag46) /de dag thams cad rgyal ba'i zhing gcig 7ci'agyur/ /des na rgyal ba 'di ltar 'gyur ba ste/ /'dren pa de'i 8ming dbang po rgyal mtshan no/ /srog chags bye ba khrag khrig mtha' yas dag /des ni 'gro srid pha rol sgrol byed de/ /'di la brtenashenas ngas ni 'dzum pa bstan/ /mod gal bu khyod de ltar shes par gyis/ /klu de lung bstan pa ni thos nas su/ /bla na med pa dag gi dga' bas khyab/ /lung bstan thos nas bar snang 'di las ni/ /ta la brgyad cu'ipha srid du mngon par 'phags/ /phyogs bcu dag na rnam dag rgyal ba'i zhing / /bzang la 47—284

grangs med 6)sangs rgyas de mthong ste/ /mthong nas sangs rgyas rkang gnyis mchog dag la/ /tshigasang bcad sna tshogs dag gis rgyal ba bstod/ /'gro ba phan skyed du 4)rgyal ba dgra las rgyal/ /dbang po thul cing ma nor de bzhin gsung //'od mdzad bden gsung khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bde gshegs tshig rmongs med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas klu'i rgyal po rgya mtshos bcom ldan 'das la tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs kyis zhu ba zhus pa/ 'jigs sel sngags grol khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /spyad pa spyod tshe sug las ci bgyis pas/ /'jigs las grol dang 'gro ba thar bgyid pa/ / 'jigs sel 4)lam zhugs bdag la bka' stsal gsol / /ji ltar 'dren pa bdag nyid 'jigs grol zhing / /skye bo 'jigs las rab tu grol mdzad pa/ /khyod kyis legs par gsungs pa'i bka' thos nas / /de bzhin ngoms med yid kyis spyad par bgyi/ /chu5bachen 'dzin pa klu yi rgya mtsho des/ /'gro la phan phyir ston la zhu byed pa/ /'jigs bcas zhe sar bcas shing de brten nas/ /mi dbang spyan sngar zhe sa phyi)bcas pas 'dug /de yi bsam pa 'dren pas thugs chud nas/ /ji ltar spyad na 'jigs dang rnam bral zhing / /sems can dag kyang 'jigs las thar byed pa/ /yan lag brgyad ldan gsung gis lung bstan to/ /byang chub spyad pa rjes su spyod bya zhing / /dbyug mtshon med pas 'gro la rab tu ston/ /chu dang thang dang de bzhin g.yul 'thab pa'i/ /'jigs la yang dang yang du 'jigs med sbyin/ /de yis legs pa'i las ni byas pas na/ /'jigs par mi 'gro byang chub regs7)'gyur la/ /mnyam par bzhag pa'i byams pa'i sems kyis su/ /shin tu mi bzad bdud stobs rab skrag byed/ /stobs bcu'i mkhyen pas rgya mtsho de dga' nas/ /de 47—285

yi skad cig sa la pus btsugs 1te/ /'jigs par mi gnas zhi bar rab 'dug nas/ /bde bar gshegs la thal sbyar phyag 'tshal byed/ /srid kun bdag la mi gnas phyag 'tshal lo/ /dngang med 'jigs bral ldan la phyag 'tshal lo / /dngang dang 'jigs las skye bo bsgral ribagyi zhing / /de bzhin gshegs pa mi dngang bdag 'gyur bgyi/ /de nas klu'i rgyal po gser gtsug pagis bcom ldan 'das la tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs kyis zhu ba zhus pa/ drang srong chen po spyan dge dbang po thul/ /srid pa'i rgya mtsho rgal cacing pha rol phyin/ /skams pal bzhugs pa srid bskams nerigang zag mchog /'gro ba'i don phyir khyod zhu bka' stsal gsol/ /ji ltar spyad na bde gshegs bdag skye zhing / /rgyal ba'i bstan la 7rab tu gnas gyur nadang / /bdud phrag stong dag gis kyang mi bskyod pa / /kun spyad 9'di dag bdag la bka' stsal gsol/ /sangs rgyas tshul la mi g.yo rab gnas shing / /klu yi gtso bos 'dren la de zhus pa/ /klu yi bdag po 1 ribasam pa thugs chud nas/ /nyon mongs kun spangs de ni lung bstan pa/ /lhag pa'i bsam pas chos kyi nges ldan zhing / /nges pa stong pa'i yul la rab tu gnas / /srid las rnam rgyal bstan la mi g.yo zhing / /gzhal med byang chub la ni 'dun pa bskyed/ /gser gtsug rdzu 'phrul che ba'i klu de ni/ /sangs rgyas gsungs pa 11thos nas the tsom 12med/ /byang chub phyir ni mi g.yo yid bskyed cing ske/ /'jigs kun pha rol phyin la mngon par bstod/ /srid mtsho rgal cing skam la shin tu bzhugs/ /the tsom 1 mi mnga' mi g.yo brtan brnyes shing / /srid par 'khor brtan 1 bzhin du rab bzhugs pa/ /ri rab ri la lha yi gnas bcas bzhin/ /'di ltar mi g.yo ba la skyabs mchi zhing / /mi g.yo ri lta bur 47—286

ni 'gyur bar bgyi/ /de'i tshe 'gul dang mi 'gul zhing mi gnas/ /mi g.yo ri rab lta bur 'gyur bar bgyi/ /ma smad pas ni de yi thugs chud nas/ /yid du 'ong ba'i dbyangs kyis lung bstan pa/ /bskal pa stong phrag brgyad cur spyad byas nas / /ma 'ongs pa yis 1dus su sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /bde ba'i lam gyis rgyal bar 'gyur ba ste/ /mtshan ni legs mthong zhes bya shin tu sdug /srog chags bye ba stong phrag thar byed cing / /bsil ba bde ba zhi ba'i lam 'god 'gyur/ /rgyal bas gsungs pa klu des dro thos nas su/ /gzhal med dga' ba'i sems ni rab dang bas/ /nyon mongs thams cad sel cing ma smad pa/ /'gro ba'i 'dren pa la ni phyag 'tshal byed/ /de nas klu'i /rgyal po ud pa la mig gis bcom ldan 'das la tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs kyis zhu ba zhus pa/ mi mchog 'dul mdzad gzi ( khebarjid mtha' yas pa/ /thugs rab zhi zhing nyer zhi pha rol gshegs / /zhi gnas yon tan rab zhi rnam grol ba/ /zhi ba mkhas pa bde bar gshegs pa gsung / /khyod sras byang chub ji ltar spyad bgyis na/ /zhi gnas dga' zhing zhi gnas bsten pa dang / /zhi gnas la ni ji ltar mkhas par 'gyur//kun gzigs myur du bdag gi som nyi khum/ /rgyal ba la ni klu 5des zhus pa dang ske/ /rgyal bas ud pal mig la lung bstan pa/ /gang gis dge ba'i las kyis nyayid 'ong ba'i/ /zhi gnas la ni shin tu bslabs 7par 'gyur/ /de phyir byang chub sems dpa' mkhas pa ni/ /spyad pa spyod tshe sems g.yor mi byed cing //bskal pa bye bar zhi gnas bsten byas 8pa/ /byang chub dam pa dpa' mchog sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /de yid rab zhi byang chub rtogs nas su/ /rnam 'dren 'gro ba zhi la sbyor byed cing / /rab tu sems zhi g.yo bar mi 'gyur la/ /47—287

sems can nyon mongs mi g.yo zhi bar byed/ /des pa ud pal mig gi klu des ni / /rgyal bas legs par gsungs pa'i tshig thos nas/ /nyon mongs kun g.yo yid ni zhi gyur te/ /byang chub mchog rab sems ni bskyed gyur to/ /de yi zhi gnas sems la brten nas su/ /byang chub sems bskyed rgyal ba de la bstod/ /khyod la bskyed nas zhi gnas rtogs gyur cing / /shin tu yid zhi sangs rgyas 'gyur bar bgyi/ /de nas klu'i rgyal po dga' bos bcom ldan 'das la tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs kyis zhu ba zhus pa/ bde bar gshegs pa zhi gnas thugs su chud/ /rgyal ba gang zag mchog la bdag zhu ba/ /khyod nyid las 'khrungs byang chub rab gnas pa/ /mi mchog ji ltar lhag mthong dag la spyad/ /mi 'dul kha lo sgyur 17la dga' bos zhus/ /klu de'i sngon gyi mtha' ni gzigs pas na / /dge ba'i las bsags pa dag thugs chud nas/ /mi 'dul kha lo sgyur ba 'di skad gsung / /ye shes dam pa byang chub mchog btsal phyir/ /ma zhum yid kyis nor dang 'bru dag la/ /ser sna med cing rdzas mang mi nyung dang / /chung ma dang ni bdag nyid gtongam2)bar byed/ /de yis legs pa'i las de byas pa dang ske/ /gtong ba shin tu sdug bsngal bsten pas na/ /ye shes dam pa bdag rgyal sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /de ni lhag mthong spyad pa'i 'bras bu yin/ /de nas klu'i rgyal po nye dga'as bcom ldan 'das la tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs kyis zhu ba zhus pa/ 'gro ba kun gyi 'dren la bdag zhu ba/ /khyod sras byang chub ji ltar spyad bgyis na/ /zhi gnas lhag mthong mnyam par spyod pa dang / /zang zing med zhi byang chub 'thob 'gyur lags/ /'dren pa de la klu des zhus pa dang ske/ /zhi gnas lhag mthong yang dag len mkhyen pa/ /thogs pa med pa 47—288

'dren pa 'di0)brnyes pas/ /de na ni bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan la bzhag /byang chub sems dpa' gang zhig spyad spyod tshe/ / gnyis ku'i' stobs 'di mnyam par bsten pas na/ /de ni bye ba khrag khrig mtha' yas zhing / /'gro ba'i don du mnyam par rnam par sbyong / /bskal pa bye ba mang po de 'tshang rgya/ /zhing gi dam pa dag kyang 'god 'gyur te/ /de'i mtha' bsngags pa bskal pa bye mang du//sangs rgyas bye bas zad par de mi spyod/ /de tshe klu yi bdag po nye dga' yis/ /theg pa mnyam pa'i bsngags5gepa thos nas su/ /gzhal du med pa'i dga' bas sems bde nas/ /byang chub mchog gi sems rab bskyed gyur to/ /'jig rten phan phyir byang chub de lung bstan(5)/ /ma 'ongs dus su sangs rgyas 'gyur ba ste/ /ming ni rgyal ba 'dren pa kun spyan gzhino/ /srog57chags bye ba stong phrag thar bar byed/ /de nas klu'i rgyal po ma dros pas bcom ldan 'das la tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs kyis zhu ba zhus pa/ bde gshegs khyod sras ji ltar spyad bgyis na/ /'gro ba'i don du phan pa tshol byed cing / /byang chub bla ma tshol la mi skyo ba/ /rkang gnyis dam pa mchog gis de lung ston/ /mi yi khyu mchog la ni klus zhus pa/ /klu yi bdag po'i bsam pa thugs chud de/ /thub pa sngon mtha' sbyorashel mi 'jigs pas/ /klu yi bdag po'i 'ithe tshom lung bstan pa/ /byang chub zhi ba spyad pa spyod 'dod pa/ /des shing 3 rmenyams pa med par spyod pa dang / /bdag dang gzhan dag la yang mi gnod cing / /ser sna med cing gtong ldan rgyal ba yin/ /de yis legs pa'i las de byas pas na/ /'gro ba gang gi 11'khor bar bde 'dod la/ /des shing thams cad du ni snying rjer ldan/ /nor byin pas ni sdud pa byed par 'gyur/ /de yis legs pa'i las 12de byas pas na//47—289

nam du'ang skye ba'i sdug bsngal myong mi 'gyur/ /rtag tu bde bas skye bo bder 'god la/ /kha na ma tho med cing gnas zhir 'jog /ston pa'i gsung gis klu de bskul bas na/ /mchog tu dga' bas sems ni bder 'gyur 1)te/ /de yis skad cig sa la pus btsugs nanas/ /tshigs rabacad sna tshogs dag gis rgyal bstod pa/ /gi tam 'jig rten kun na mnyam med de/ /'gro ba zil mnan bde gshegs lhang nge ba/ /khyod kyi zhal du lhar bcas 'gro kun blta/ /'di ltar thal mo sbyar nas skyabs su mchi/ /byang chub mchog gi yid ni bskyed bgyi zhing ske/ /'di ltar bde gshegs khyod kyi ye shes dang / /ston pa khyod kyis the tsom rabasal ba ltar/ /bdag kyang thos nas 'jig rten the tsom 6bsal de nas de'i 7ston gzhal med byang chub phyir/ /yid ni shin tu dgyes nas bka' stsal pa/ /'jig rten phan phyir 'dren par 'gyur ba yi/ /mi mchog ming ni dbang po chen po'o/ /de nas klu'i rgyal po e nar pa nas bcom ldan 'das la tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs kyis 95zhu ba zhus pa1 / 'jig rten dpag med mang po'i skyabs kyi mchog /rgyal ba the tshom 11gcod la zhu bgyi ba15/ /byang chub sems dpas sug las ci bgyis na/ /sangs rgyas mngon du lhan cig phrad pa 'thob / /'jig rten mgon po de la klus zhus nas/ /'jig rten phan phyir 'dren pas lung bstan pa/ /sems can rgyud la nyon mongs rnam rig dang / /yongs su dul ba'i yid ni rnam shes nas/ /'gro la phan phyir snying rje bskyed nas sum/ /byang chub mchog gi 1 don du spyad pa spyod/ /bdag dang rgyal bar ji ltar phrad snyam nas/ /thabs la mkhas par mngon par rab gnas te/ /rgyal ba rnams dang bde gshegs mya ngan 'das/ /sku gdung dag la gzhal med mchod 47—290

byed cing / /rnam grol yid kyis smon lam 'debs par byed/ /de yis legs pa'i las de byas pas na/ /rtag tu sangs rgyas mngon par phrad 'thobs1ste/ /rgyal ba mngon sum mchod pa byas nas su/ /byang chub dga' ba 'od ldan reg par 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas kyis ni legs gsungs tshig thos nas/ /e ra pa na klu ni yid mgu ste/ /gzhal du med pa'i dga' bas sems bde nas/ / dad pa'i nayid kyis sangs rgyas mngon bstod pa/ /mi 'dul kha lo sgyur la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khyod kyis bdag gi som nyi the tshom bsal / /byang chub don du yid 'di bskyed bgyi ste/ /sdug bsngal mthar bgyid sangs rgyas 'gyur bar bgyi / /gang zag bdag gis klu yi bdag 4po yi/ /bsam pa thugs chud byang chub lung bstan pa/ /bskal pa bye ba brgyad 5cu rtsa bzhi ru/ / spyad pa spyod nenas de nas sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /mi mchog mtshan ni thams cad sgrol ba ste/ /srog chags bye ba stong phrag thar bar byed/ /de yi ring bsrel mang por 'gyur ba ste / /skye bo mang po mtho ris 'gro bar 'gyur/ /klu de ston pa'i gsung gis dga' gyur nas/ /'jig rten phan mdzad rnam 'dren mngon bstod pa/ /khyod kyis 'gro ba'i don ni rgya cher mdzad/ /sdug bsngal mthar 7mdzad sangs rgyas phyag 'tshal lo// //bam po bcu gnyis pa/ de nas klu'i rgyal po tshib pa'i bus bcom ldan 'das la tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs kyis zhu ba zhus pa/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten don sladang du/ /'jig rten don mdzad rnam 'dren la zhu ba/ /spyad 9pa spyod tshe sug las ci bgyis pas/ /ma rtogs rtogs nas rgyal ba rnam 'dren 'gyur / /tshib pa'i bu des rgyal la 1 mngon zhus nas/ /nyon mongs thams cad 47—291

bsal bas lung bstan pa/ /dge ba'i las kyis 'bras bu yid 'ong zhing / /nyon mongs bcom pas des na rgyal zhes bya/ /de ni 'gro kun tshetshamedang sangs rgyas la/ /mchog tu dang bsan dag gisasposasems kyang shes/ /de yis las kyis)lam de byas pas na/ /'gro ba'i rtag 9pa rgyal ba dag tu 'gyur/ /de yis rgyal ba'i bshad pa thos nas su/ /'gro ba thams cad la ni dad par byas/ /de tshe de yis dge ba byas pas na/ /'di yi smon lam btab 6)ltar bdag 'gyur ro/ /de nas 'jig rten mgon pos de lung bstan/ /mi mchog sangs rgyas su ni 'gyur ba ste/ /srog chags bye ba stong phrag thar byed cing / /spyad pa spyod tshe rgyal ba mngon par bstod/ /ston pa'i gsung gis klu de dga' gyur〈penas/ /sangs rgyas la ni dad bskyed mngon bstod pa/ /'gro ba thar mdzad sangs rgyas phyag 'tshal lo/ /bsam yas bde gshegs khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas klu'i rgyal po nag pos bcom ldan 'das la tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs kyis zhu ba zhus pa/ drang srong chen po skyabs mchog dpag tu med/ /skyon dang bral zhing yon tan mchog brnyes pa/ /stobs bcu'i 'jigs pas rnam gnon khyod la ni / /byang chub zhi spyod mkhas pa rab gnas zhu2)/ /des pa'i nyon mongs ji ltar bsal ba dang / /rgyal ba'i mchog nyid ji ltar bsgom par bgyiyo)/ /bdud kyi spyod yul de dag ji ltar spang / /sangs rgyas spyod yul dag la ji ltar spyad/ /rgyal ba la ni klu des zhus pa dang / /ji ltar bde gshegs spyod yul spyad pa dang //ji ltar bdud kyi spyod yul spang ba dag /lam gnyis shin tu mkhyen pas0merab tu bstan12/ /ston pa la ni klu bdag des zhus nas/ /de yi bsam pa thugs chud lung bstan pa/ /mi mkhas gang dag sems can 'du shes spyod/ /de dag 47—292

nag po'i rtsa lag spyod yul spyod/ /gang dag sems can med cing yid mi gnas//de dag thams cad gzigs pa'i spyod yul spyod/ /nag po'i rtsa lag dag las rgyal nas su/ /byang chub bla med zhi ba des thob po/ /ston pa'i gsung gis klu de dga' gyur nas/ /bdud kyi spyod yul myur bar rnam spangs te/ /sangs rgyas thams cad gzigs ltar spyod yul dag /bsten pas de ni myur du rgyal bar 'gyur/ /de nas klu'i rgyal po go ta mas bcom ldan 'das la tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs kyis zhu ba zhus pa/ kha lo sgyur mchog khyod la zhumanyu)bgyi ba/ /'dren pa khyod sras ji ltar spyad55)bgyis nas/ /klu yi skye gnas dag ni gcod bgyid cing / /sangs rgyas tshul gyi myu gu bskyedango kyipar bgyid/ /bde bar gshegs la klu des zhus pa dang / /de yi bsam pa thugs chud lung bstan pa/ /sems can med la rgyal ba'i sras spyod cing / /byang chub sems la nams kyangachade mi gnas/ /de ni stong nyid khong du chud pa yin/ /mkhas pa mtshan ma smon lam rnam spangs shing / /mdzangasa' pa mi dmigs pa la gnas pa dag /'di ni sangs rgyas chos mngon myu gu bskyed/ /ston pa'i gsung gis klu cismo)de dga' gyur nas / /mi dmigs pa la brten par rab gnas shing / /bdud kyi zhags bcings57dam pa bcad nas su/ /sangs rgyas tshul la klu 8)ni rab tu gnas/ /'jig rten mkhas pas byang chub de lung bstan/ /ma 'ongs dus su sangs rgyas 'gyur ba ste/ /rnam thar 9rgyal zhes phyogs su rnam grags shing / /bdud kyi dbang song srog chags thar bar byed/ /ston pa'i gsung gis klu de dga' gyur nas / /thal mo sbyar nas sangs rgyas phyag 'tshal byed/ /khyod kyi lam bstan pas na sangs rgyas bsten/ /mi mchog thar mdzad zhing la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de 47—293

nas klu'i rgyal po kum pa la'i sgras bcom ldan 'das la tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs kyis zhu ba zhus pa/ zla ba'i 'od ltar dri med mthu che zhing / /mi mchog rang byung gyur la zhu bgyi ba/ /rnam 'dren sras ni ji ltar spyad bgyis na/ /phan par 'jug cing rjes su skye bar 'gyur/ /gal te stong nyid smon med rjes song zhing ske/ /phung po mtshan ma 1mi ldan bral ba dang / /nam mkha' 'dra ba'i chos dang rnam 2shes na/ /pha yi lam du bu yang rjes 'gro 'gyur/ /ston pas legs par gsungs pa de dga' nas/ /dmigs su med pa yi ni sems bskyed do/ /'jig rten mkhas pas byang chub de lung bstan/ /rjes su 'thun 'di spyod pa spyad byas shing / /zhing mchog dag kyang yongs su sbyangs nas su/ /ma 'ongs dus su sangs rgyas 'gyur ba ste/ /zla bas lhag par phyogs su rnam grags shing / /srid par 'gro ba'i sems can thar bar byed/ /kum pa la zhes ming btags klu de ni/ /shākya sras mkhas byang chub lung bstan nas/ /sems ni dga' zhing yongs su yid mgu ste/ /'gro kun thar bar mdzad la mngon bstod pa/ /thub pa che la 'di ltar skyabs su mchi/ /sangs rgyas 'gyur bar the tshom bdag ma mchis / /mun pa dag la sgron ma gzung 4bgyi zhing / /long ba mig ma mchis la lam bstan bgyi/ /de nas klu'i bdag po yul 'khor srung 5gis bcom ldan 'das la tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs kyis zhu ba zhus 6pa/ mgon po 'jig rten long bar gyur pa'i 7mig /mig sbyin sman pa drang srong che la zhu/ /gang gis 'jig rten rnam thar lam bzang zhing / /zhi ba'i sar mchis rkang gnyis dbang po gsungs/ /stobs bcu'i stobs mnga' rnam par 8thar ba'i 9lam ston pa / /'jig rten mgon po rkang gnyis dbang pos de lung bstan/ /gang gis 47—294

yun ring zhugs pa'i sdug bsngal lam zhi zhing / /'khor ba nyer zhi mya ngan 'das pa gsal bar 'gro/ /ston la klu yi rgyal po lam zhi thos nas su/ /sdug bsngal ba la snying rje dam pa bskyed byas shing / /klu yi rgyal pos byang chub 'dun pa drag bskyed de17/ /stobs bcu'i stobs 'chang 'jig rten mgon du bdag 'gyur byed / /stobs bcu'i yon tan mnga' bas klu dbang lung bstan pa/ /mi yi seng ge bdag nyid mu stegs dgrar 'gyur zhing / /sems can mtha' yas dpag med 'khor bar 'gro ba dag /bde gshegs mchog gi tshig gis 'dren cing thar bar byed/ /ston tshonapa'i gsung mchog klu yi rgyal pos thos nas su/ /dga' ba'i sems kyis sor bcu'i rtse mo thal sbyar te/ /mi dbang 'jig rten mgon po drang srong chen po la/ /gus pa bskyed nas 'khrul med tshig gis mngon bstod pa/ /skyabs mchog shin tu thugs gzhungs mtshungs med ye shes tog /'gro ba'i dge ba spyod cing dge la yun ring dang / /'gro ba'i bsam pa mtha' yas khyod kyis thugs chud pas/ /des na ci —mi dbang khyod ni 'jig rten rgya cher grags/ /de nas klu'i rgyal po gser mgrin gyis bcom ldan 'das la tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs kyis zhu ba zhus pa/ stobs bcu'i stobs mnga' stobs che stobs dang ldan pa ste/ /thugs dge snang mdzad 'od dang ldan zhing lasdig mi mnga'/ /srid rgyal blo gros bzang bas pa'agro ba shin tu mkhyen/ /rgyal ba dge spyod shin tu dri med zhal gsungs shig /mi nemachog rdul bral khyod sras ji ltar spyad bgyis na/ /mkhas pa ma dkrugs ma bskyod pa dag thugs chud cing / /rgyal ba rdul bral dpag med brgya ni yongs su mkhyen/ /rgyal sras skye bo phan mdzad thugs su chud pa'i spyan/ /blo gros dpag med mnga' ba lha mi mkhas pa yis/ /bla mar bgyis 47—295

shing rgyal ba dpag med sa yas bskor/ /mkhas pa dus su 'gro ba dpag med phan mdzad dgongs/ /stobs bcu mnga' ba klu yi 'gro ba zhus pa gsungs/ /blo 'chal bral zhing blo gtsang rjes dgongs brtag pa mdzod/ /ngamagyo)yi sras mchog rgyal bstenartson/rga shi zad byed pa/ /'thob cing rgyal bas mchod cing rdul med skyon bral re/ /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal dpag med brgya shes yongs su 'grol/ /stobs bcu blo gros mnga' bas klu yi bdag po yis/ /rga shi zad bya thos nas rab tu yid dga' ste/ /'gro la phan yid byang chub yid byas rgyal ba'i mchog /rnam 'dren blo mnga' 'gro la phan mdzad mngon bstod pa/ /'gro ba mang po'i mun pa rab rib ling tog (spyodag /gcod mdzad 'gro 'di'i sdug bsngal 'joms shing mun pa dang / /rab rib ling tog⑧kun nas sel mdzad bdud rtsi'i lam/ /shin tu dri med spyan mnga' dge ba phyogs bcur ston/ /klu yi bdag po'i gser dngul lta bu'i khyim gshegs shing / /yon tan dpag med mnga' ba shin tu thugs su chud/ /blo gros ston mdzad 'od zer stongakhe'adra'i spyan mnga' zhal/ /ma 'khrul ma glongasapo)ma smad gzi che mkhas pa'i gzi/ /stobs bcu 7/'od chen mnga' la 'gro ba'i tshig gis bstod/ /rgyal mchog bdag nyid bde ldan sangs rgyas byang chub nas/ /'gro ba 'khyams shing mngon med rga shi sdug bsngal gyis/ /nyam thag sdug bsngal dpag med bsal te thar bar bgyi/ /bde dang zhi dang zhi ba rdul med rgya che sel/ /zhi ba'i lam du zhugs nas bdag ni sangs rgyas bgyi/ /rgyal ba brgyalo8)yis thugs chud 3)bdud kyi stobs dag ni/ /stobs med bgyi zhing mi mkhas pa dag gzhug par bgyi/ /de nas klu'i rgyal po mgrin sngon gyis bcom ldan 'das la tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs kyis zhu ba 47—296

zhus pa/ ston mchog mi hu)'dulamacho kha lo sgyur la zhu bgyi ba/ /'dren pa khyod kyi sras ni ji ltar spyad bgyis na/ /kha na ma tho med cing zhi la rdul bral dang / /nyon mongs med cing byang chub dam pa sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /'gro ba'i don du 'dren pas gsungs pa gang / /dpa' bo khyod nyid las 'khrungs sras thos nas/ /kha na ma tho med cing bdag dang gzhan/ /sangs rgyas 'gyur dang byang chub the tshom khum/ /mgrin sngon klu de yis ni zhus pa dang / /'jig rten kun la chags pa med pa'i thugs/ /chos rnams kun la mi 'jigs dbang brnyes shing / /ston pa'i gsung la legs gnas lung bstan pa/ /nga sras 'jig rten gsum la ma chags shing / /'gro la phan par spyad pa spyod byed pa/ /'dod pa'i khams dang gzugs kyi khams dag dang / /gzugs med khams su'ang ched du mi skye'o/ /mya ngan 'das dbyings gzhal med 'dus ma byas/ /thams cad kyi ni sdug bsngal zad cing 'gog /de ni nyer bzung 'jig rten gos med yin/ /rgyal ba rgyal ba'i dbang po rab tu bsgom / /de yis legs pa'i las de byas pas na/ /gos pa med cing 'jigs med rnam spyod la/ /bdag dang gzhan la gnod pa med gnas te/ /bdag nyid bla med byang chub mngon 'tshang rgya(7/ /de ni rnam smin de las rjes 'thun pa/ /shin tu dga' bas byang chub 'tshang rgyar 'gyur/ /de yi skye bo srog chags lha dang klu/ /mi dang srin po dag gis mi mthong ngo / klu mgrin sngon po stobs po che de ni/ /sangs rgyas kun mkhyen gsung gis dga' gyur nas/ /sor mo bcu yi thal sbyar mgo btud de/ /'jig rten sgron mdzad 'dren la phyag 'tshal byed/ /mi mchog la ni 'di ltar bdag skyabs mchi/ /yab kyi rjes su sras kyang mchi bgyi zhing / /mthar bgyid bcom la byang chub 47—297

'tshang rgyar bgyi/ /sems can sdug bsngal chos kyis gnod gyur dgrol/ /'jig rten mkhas pas byang chub de lung bstan/ /khyod ni ma 'ongs dus su 'tshang rgya ste/ /kun tu spyan zhes phyogs su rnam grags shing / /'gro ba'i srid las sems can grol bar byed/ /de nas klu'i rgyal po 'jigs sgrogs kyis tshotshobacom ldan 'das la tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs kyis zhu ba zhus pa/ mi 'dul kha lo sgyur ba 2yid las 'das/ /ston pa sug las ci bgyis 5ribadag zhu'o/ /rgyal ba de ni snam phyogs gzigs pa na/ /dkyil 'khor tsam gyis ni mdun ciltadu 'gyur/ /chos la nges pa'i rgyal bas de lung bstan/ /kun mkhyen mkhyen pas bsam pa thugs chud nas/ /bla na med pa'i thugs ni bskyed mdzad de/ /de bzhin mi mchog gis ni 'di lung bstan/ /bde ba 'byung ba dag gi las byas shing ske/ /de dag sngan 'chad yang dang yang dran pas/ /de yi rnam smin las ni 'di ltar shes/ /de yi gzigs par sa ni 'gyur ba yin/ /rgyal bas legs gsungs tshig ni thos nas su/ /klu rgyal de ni mchog tu dga' gyur nas/ /'phags pa'i 7zang zing med pa'i dga' bskyed de/ /nga rgyal bcom nas sangs rgyas phyag 'tshal byed/ /de nas klu'i rgyal po gzi can gyis bcom ldan 'das la tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs kyis zhu ba zhus pa/ lam stor ba la lam ni rab ston cing / /'jig rten don mdzad 'dren la zhu bgyi ba/ /sngon tshe rtag tu phrin las ci mdzad na/ /ji ltar dgongs pa bzhin du zhi gnas mdzad/ /'jig rten mgon po 8rgyal bas de lung bstan/ /sems can klu ni gdul 9ba'i dus bab cing / /'gro ba thams cad la ni phan pa'i phyir/ /'dren pa bdud stobs 'joms pas lung bstan pa/ /'das pa'i dus su spyad pa spyod pa'i tshe/ /tshul 47—298

bzhin ma yin sems dang gnyen min pa'i/ /nams 1kyang mi sems rtag tu zhi gnas bsten/ /de la ngas ni yun ring bslabs napa yin/ /de bzhin rgyal ba dag gi rimachod rten la/ /phreng ba rin chen dag ni bkram zhing phul/ /de yis legs pa'i las de byas pas san/ /nyon mongs sems dang nams kyang mi gnas so / /nga yis bskal pa stong phrag bye 5ba ru/ /gzhan la gnod pas nams 6)kyang gnod ma byas / /nga ni de yis las kyi rnam smin rgyus/ /ji ltar bsams 8bzhin zhi gnas sten 9)par byed/ /drang srong che bas lung bstan 'di thos nas/ /gzi can klu ni dga' bar gyur pa na/ /gzhal du med pa'i bde bas sems dga' nas/ /ston pa'i mdun 'dug tshigs su bcad pas bstod/ /'gro ba'i kun ldang nyon mongs zhi mdzad cing / /de dag sems zhi khyod kyi 1 bstan pa mdzad / /thub pa nyon mongs med par 'jig rten spyod/ /zla 'od lta bur 11blo zhi phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas klu'i rgyal po rnam par snang byed kyis bcom ldan 'das la tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs kyis zhu ba zhus pa/ sngon tshe dag tu phrinas12las ci mdzad na/ /thub pa khyod kyis 1lhasku la rdul mi gos/ /dpe med rnams miganon 'di dag bdag la gsungs/ /gang dag thos nas dge ba'i las spyad bgyi / /rnam par snang byed dge ba tshol ba'i klus/ /'jig rten mgon de la ni zhus pa dang / /nyon mongs kun sel yan lag brgyad ldan zhing / /snyan cing 'jebs pa'i sgras ni lung bstan pa/ /nga yis sngon chad byang chub tshol ba na/ / nams kyang mtshul bzhin ma yin ngas ma bsams/ / nams kyang tsharab tu nyes sems ngas ma bskyed/ /bla med byams las yang dang yang du byas/ /nga yis dge ba'i las de byas pas na/ /bla med byang chub zhi ba reg nas su/ /mi 47—299

mchog rgyal ba thub pa'i sku dag dang / /na bza' la yang rdul gyis 3)mi gos so/ /rgyal ba'i phrin nalas dge bsags de thos nas/ ji /rnam par snang byed klu ni yid dga' ste/ /sor bcu'i thal mo sbyar nas mgo bo yis/ /rgyal ba'i zhabs la mngon par phyag 'tshal byed/ /legs so rgyal ba mu byed sngon du gshegs/ /khyod kyis rgya che mtha' yas ridon dag mdzad/ /srid pa'i tshogs la dga' zhing sdug bsngal gyis/ /gdungs pa'i 'gro ba mtha' dag khyod kyis bkrol44/ /skye bo dug gdug rig 5pa'i sman pa ste/ /skye bo dug bcom khyod ni gso sman lags/ /me 'bar zhi ltar rim gyis mya ngan 'da'/ /'di ltar thal sbyar mgos btud skyabs su mchi/ /de nas klu'i rgyal po bsgyings pas bcom ldan 'das la tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs kyis zhu ba zhus pa/ rnam 'dren dge ba'i phrin 55kyilas ci mdzad na/ /zhabs ni shin tu mnyam zhing brtan 77pa brnyes/ /gang dag thos nas shin tu yid dga' 'thob/ /mi yi mchog gyur de dag bdag la gsungs/ / klu yi 8rgyal po bsgyings pas rnam par 'dren/ /'jig rten mkhas la de yis zhus pa dang / /yid du 'ong ba'i tshigs bcad sna tshogs kyis/ /klu yi rgyal po 59)yid ni dga' bar gyur/ /nga yis tshul khrims brtul zhugs rnam dag tshabasgrubs//nga yis gzhan yang tshul khrims brtul zhugs bsgoms/ /ngas ni dge ba'i las de byas pas na/ /rkang pa mnyam pa dag gis sa la reg /de tshe thams cad mkhyen pas lung bstan pa/ /rdul bral klu ni yid dga' mgu gyur nas/ /gzhal du med pa'i bde bas sems dga' ste/ /sangs rgyas rkang gnyis mchog la phyag 'tshal byed/ /legs so rgyal ba 'od mdzad rdul bcom zhing / /shin tu nyon mongs bag chags bcas pa bcom/ /zla nya'i 31dkyil 'khor sgra gcan gyis 47—300

btangamanyu)ltar/ /dgra bcom nas ni phyogos rnams rab tu gsal/ /de nas klu'i rgyal po 'od chen gyis bcom ldan 'das la tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs kyis zhu ba zhus pa/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten sman slad du/ /'jig rten 'das gsung 'dren la zhu bgyi ba/ /rkang gnyis dam pa sug las ci bgyis na/ /rnam 'dren gnas ma lagasamachinaripa 'tshal ba 'thob/ /sngon tshe dag tu spyad pa spyod pa na la/ /lus dang ngag yid dang ni sems kyis kyang / /bde ba 'byung ba'i yang dag las byas te/ /las gang byas pas nams kyang cagadung mi 'gyur/ /rab tu dga' zhing dge bas brlan pa dang / /gnas ma yin pa'i lam gyodam57thams cad ni/ /dge bcu las kyi lam gyis rnam par sbyangs/ /gnas ma yin pa'i nyon mongs thams cad bcom/ /rnam 'dren de yis las de mdzad pas na/ /'di nas 'phos nas gzhan 'phrul dag tu gshegs/ /mi yis451'jig rten brnyes nas der 'das te/ /bla med gnas ma yin pa shes pa 'thob/ /gnas ma yin pa shes la nams kyang (1)ni/ /bye ba khrag khrig bdud kyis bskyod mi nus/ /sems dang de bzhin nyon mongs yid grol te/ /de bzhin gshegs pas 'gro kun rab tu mkhyen/ /ston pas lung bstan pas ni 'od chen klu/ /yid ni shemagu zhing shin tu dga' 'gyur7te/ /gzhal du med pa'i bde bas sems dga' nas / /yon tan pha rol gshegs la phyag 'tshal byed/ /shin tu thugs dul yid gnyis 'joms pa ponyu tsho/ /'dam las rgal cing skams 31la shin tu bzhugs//thub chen rgal cing 'gro ba sgrol mdzad pa/ /ji ltar nyi mas mun pa bsal nas su / /gzugs kyi rnam pa snang zhing gsal ba ltar/ /de bzhin ston pa'i thugs ni rnam grol zhing / /sems can sdug bsngal mang gnod mthar 32mdzad pa/ /47—301

mig sbyin gso ba'i dpyad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas klu'i rgyal po rab tu gdung byed kyis bcom ldan 'das la tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs kyis zhu ba zhus pa/rgyal ba gser mdog phrin 1las ci mdzad na/ /dus gsum mkhyen la rab tu brtan par bzhugs/ /nam mkha' lta bur mkhyen ldan zhu bgyis pa/ /'gro ba'i 'dren pas 2de dag bdag la gsungs/ /thogs med mkhyen pas thugs ni ma chags shing / /som nyi gcod la the tsoms sel mdzad pa/ /rgyal ba rang byung thugs kyis de'i bsam pa/ /shin tu thugs chud de ni lung bstan pa/ /rtag tu dge ba dran ldan sten byed cing / /nges pa'i las byas pas dza)ni bde 'byung dang ske/ /rtag tu gzhan yang shes la 'jog byed cing / /bdag nyid ji tsam shes pa ser sna med/ /mkhas pa de yis las de byas pas na/ /lus zhig nas ni gzhan 'phrul dag tu 'gro/ /'dod pa dag na spyod pa'i lha gnas dang / /thur du 'bab cing mi yi bar 'du 'byung / /dus gsum shes la rnam par rtsem nobyed cing / /bdag dang de bzhin gzhan yang shes par byed/ /pags she)pa srab cing blo dang ldan gyur pa/ /bde gshegs thogs pa med pas lung bstan to/ /shin tu blo 9ldan mchog gis bstan thos nas/ /klu 1 chen rab tu gdung byed dga' gyur te/ /byang chub gzhal du med la rab gnas shing / /yang dag bsngags pas mi mchog rgyal ba bstod11/ /dus gsum mtshan nyid gcig tu gzigs mdzad cing / /las dang rnam smin de bzhin rab tu mkhyen/ /sems can dag gi khyad par bde ba mkhyen/ /bde gshegs thams cad gtong la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas klu'i rgyal po stobs chen gyis bcom ldan 'das la tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs kyis zhu ba zhus pa/ /mi mchog mchog rab mkhyen rab mtha' 47—302

yas pa/ /mgon po rdul bral thugs ni yongs su dag /bdag gi som nyi myur sol the tsom 1yang / /skyen par dgum phyir bde bar gshegs pas gsungs/ /ji ltar sngon tshe mi dang lha dag gis/ /sug las bgyis pa blo mkhas ji ltar 'tshal / /ji ltar bla med byang chub mchog thob pa/ /bdag gis the tsoms zhus pa myur bar gsungs/ /stobs bcu'i stobs mkhyen bdag nyid shin tu nges/ /rgyal las klu yis zhus pa myur gsung ste/ /nga yis ji ltar mi yi spyod kun dang / /dge ba'i bsam pas byang chub tshol 45byed cing / /ji ltar yid rab dga' bas bsgrubs pa dang / /ji ltar skye dgu 5sdug bsngal gyis gnod 6cing / /tha ma mthong la ngan 'gror ltung ba dang / /nyon mongs brgya yis mun par gyur pa shes//der ni sems can snying pos snying rje bskyed/ /nga yis sems can 'di dag sdug bsngal dgrol/ /thar bar 'gyur ba'i lam mchog dag tu bzhag /nga yis ngan 'gro dag gi lam ngan dgag /nga yis lam mchog zhi ba rab tu bstan/ /bde ba'i lam gyis byang chub zhi bar bkur/ /stobs bcu'i lam mchog rab tu bstan bya zhing / /yun ring mi dag gis 75ni don 'gyur bya/ /de ltar brtan rin pa des ni snying rje bskyed/ /drang srong chen pos 9dge tshul bsgrubs nas su/ /mgo dang mig dang de bzhin sha dag ni/ /btang nas bde gshegs lam nas dpa' bo 'gro / /sngon gyi dus su mi yis spyad pa ni/ /de tshe rmi lam lta bur rab tu mkhyen//dge ba 'di dag mi yis shes pa na/ /stobs bcu mnga' la mchod pa rtsol bar byed / /mgon la gzhal med de bzhin dad bskyed nas/ /ji ltar 'gro kun mgon du bdag 'gyur snyam/ /ji ltar skye bo phongs tshe bdag gis ni/ /stobs bcus bstan pa'i lam la gzhag par bya/ /1 dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di dag bsten pa 47—303

na / /'dren pa dag gis spyadamatshol rjes su bslab/ /bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig mtha' yas su/ /lam gol song ba rnams la lam mchog bstan/ /'di ltar bdag nyid chen po'i spyad spyod na/ / mi yis pasngon gyi phrin ri — las byas pa mthong ske/ /rmi lam lta bur byas par rnam rig cing / /de ni dran la pha rol dag la'ang ston/ /stobs bcu mnga' ba'i bka' ni thos nas su/ /stobs chen klu ni yid dga' mgu 4)gyur nas/ /sor bcu'i thal mo spyi bor sbyar btud degs / /byang chub zhi thob bya phyir rgyal ba bstod/ /rnam par 'dren la bdag gis dad bskyed 6pas/ /stobs bcu'i mdzad pa dag ni bdag gis bgyi/ /skye bo lam gol 'gro zhing mun gyur rnams/ /byang chub zhi ba thob par bdag gis bgyi/ /de nas klu'i rgyal po sprin chen pos bcom ldan 'das la tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs kyis zhu ba zhus pa/ stobs bcu mnga' ba skye bo yongs grol mdzad/ /'dren pa rang byung la ni bdag 'di zhu/ /ji ltar ston pa'i sras kyis brtson bskyed na/ /zhi ba rdul med byang chub mchog 'thob 7)'gyur/ /ji ltar 'bad pa'i brtson 'grus stobs kyis su/ /bla med byang chub byang chub sems 'thob pa/ /yon tan dpag med ye shes mchog mnga' ba'i/ /drang srong chen pos sras zhus lung bstan pa/ /byang chub don du nga yis sngon spyad pa/ /ji ltar 'gro ba rnams su stobs brtson bsten/ /brtson 'grus stobs kyi ri byang chub ngas brnyes pa/ /de ni nga yis cung zad bshad par bya/ /'das pa'i dus su mi bdag byung ba ni/ /mi yi dbang phyug mi dbang stobs 'chang zhes/ /rin chen bdun yod bu dang ldan pa ste/ /bdag las skyes pa khri phrag brgya dag byung / /de tshe 'jig rten khams 'di'ang rgyas pa ste/ /ri bong bdag ces sangs rgyas zhing dag byung / /47—304

der ni mi mchog rang byung byung gyur pa/ /rin chen dpal zhes 'jig rten sgra rnams grags/ /mi mchog de yis 1)nyan thos dge 'dun ni/ /sa yamadu phrag ni brgyad cu dag byung ngo / /bde gshegs mchog gi rjes skyes sras tshogs ni/ /nyon mongs khro dang nga rgyal 'chang dbral ba'i ni/ /de tshe mi mchog de yi byang chub sems / /sa ya phrag ni brgyad cu dag byung ste/ /rgyal ba dpag med dag la spyad ldan zhing / /'gro la phan phyir byang chub 'thob 'gyur ro/ /de namar rnam par 'dren pa de yi ni/ /byang chub sems dpa' bdud bsten ri tsho/zhes byas57)byung / /drang srong chen po bdud stobs rab 'joms pa/ / de yis 2)tshogs kyis9)gtso bo de byed do/ /de nas bdud stobs bsnyen par dka' zhes pa/ /lha'i bu byung nas 'dren pa rgyal ba'i mchog /de ni byang chub mchog tu gshegs pa la/ /ji ltar mi reg bya phyir bar chad byed/ /sa 'di rgya mtshor bcas pa yon tan ldan/ /de dag bud med tshogs kyis mngon sprul te/ /bzang mo yon tan rab mchog 'dzin pas bkang / /dga' ba'i tshig dang yid 'ong tshig smra zhing / /mig ni bzang la 'gros kyang ldem bag can/ /glang po'i 31sna ltar lag mnyam pa yi mdog /yun ring dag tu brtul zhugs 'dzin pa ste/ /nu ma sra la legs dang ldan pa yin/ /ngag tshig snyan cing pad ma 'dra ba'i 12mig /so yi phreng ba thags dmas3ge'achang ba ste/ /byi thur+ya'i mdog ltar mchu ni mdzes pa yin/ /bzhin dang 'gram pa dag ni mdzes dang ldan/ /bzhin gyi mdog ni zla ba dri med 'phrog /'dzum zhing tshig ni snyan pa gtong geb ste/ /glang mchog myos pa lta bur mdzes pa'i 'gros/ /ngo tsha shes pas blo gros ngan pa spangs/ /nu ma sra zhing tshigs kyis zin pa ste/ /ri dgas 7rgyal po lta bur de'i 3 molus 'chang bzang 47wa 305

mo'i lus ngos srab cing 'jam dang ldan/ /ri dgas 17rgyal po'i byin 'dra rtse 'gro zhing / /rkang pa mnyam 2la 'jol ba'i thabs su 'gro/ /'dod chags ldang bar 'gyur ba'i bu mo dag /bdud kyis sa rnams thams cad gang byas pa/ /dmar ba zung du ldan pa'i myos ma ste/ /bdud kyis bdud kyi zhags pa mdun du bstan/ /de yi 'dod pa bdud stobs thams cad dag /de tshe bskyed nas bdud bsten 'jigs byas kyang / /nag po'i rtsa lag de yis gtse ma nus/ /bar chad bya bar rab tu ma tshugs so/ /de nas shin tu mi bzad srin po ni/ / bye ba cadag gis tshig rtsub smra bar byed/ /dpag tu med cing bsam yas mu med pa'i5te/ /lus bong mtha' yas mngon sprul tshig rtsub smra/ /mdung thung mda' bo che yis rgyob shig 'argyob/ /'di yi glad 7pa myur du ri yis chomachin// /'di yi snying la gzi brjid yod pa phrogs9/ /myur du dus las 'da' zhing 'gog par gyis10 / /thang cig 11tsam yang 'di ni srog ma sbyin/ /ji ltar 'dod pa'i yon tan de 12bsten na/ /bdag gi rgyal srid gnod pa med par 'gyur/ /nga yi yang dag tshig de thos nas su/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa 'phel bar ma byed cig /de tshe bong 1 bu'i rnam pa mngon sprul pa/ /mgo gcig 1 pa dang mgo gnyis pa dag byung / /srin po rnams ni sgra bo che dag 'bod/ /la la mdung dang mda' bo che dag thogs/ /la la dag kyang ri ni khyer ba ste/ /la la sdang ba'i sems kyis sprul 'dzin cing d+ku/ /de yi mdun du shin tu sgra dag 'byin/ /de tshe la la gnod sbyin mngon sprul te/ /lus gcig pa dang lus gnyis lag pa ni/ /gsum dag yod cing lus bzhi lag pa gcig /de tshe lus gcig mngon par sprul byas shing / /de tshe de bzhin mgo bzhi mngon par sprul/ /de nas lus gcig 47—306

mngon par sprul byas te/ /de dag bong 41bu ra dang byi la dang / /stag gi gdong ste 'jigs par byed pa dag /so so mi 'dra ba yi skad dag 'byin/ /bong bu'i gdong ni ra yi skad 'byin cing / /ra yi gdong ni bong bu'i skad 'byin la/ /bong bu glang po'i skad dang rta skad 'byin/ /bong 2bu gcig gi kha nas skad kun 'byin / /de tshe ra yi kha nas thams cad skad/ /shin tu 'jigs skad dpag tu med pa 'byin/ /gzhan yang bde gshegs bsnyen par bya ba'i phyir/ /glang po kha nas tshig rtsub dpag med 'byin/ /de tshe glang po bong cabu'i skad 'byin cing //de bzhin rta dang de bzhin glang po dag /rnam pa mtha' yas skad dag 'byin byed kyang / /bde gshegs ba spu'i khung bu'ang ma g.yos so/ /rta ni glang po'i skad dag 'byin byed cing / /de bzhin spre'u ni rta yi skad dag 'byin/ /spre'u'i kha nas mtha' yas skad 'byin kyang / /bde gshegs ba spu'i khung yang g.yos ma gyur / /ri dgas 5rgyal po wa yi skad 'byin cing / /bong bu'i phyugs dang bya byi rta skad 'byin/ /de tshe rnam 'dren gtse 6bar ma nus shing / /ba spu'i khung bu'ang g.yos par ma gyur to/ /de tshe stag ni phag gi skad 'byin cing / /de tshe phyugs dang bya ni sbrul skad 'byin/ /rnam 'dren de ni gtse bar ma nus shing / /bar chad bya ba dag tu'ang ma tshugs so/ /ri dgas 7byu mchog seng ge'i skad 'byin cing / /byi la wa ni phag gi skad 'byin la/ /ma he dag ni stag gi skad 'byin kyang / /'jig rten mkhas pa bar chad bya ma nus/ /de bzhin phyugs kyi kha nas mtha' yas pa/ /rnam pa bye ba sems can skad 'byin kyang / /rnam 'dren de ni gtse na bar ma nus shing / /bar chad bya ba dag tu'ang ma tshugs so/ /stag ni ri dgas 9khu mchog skad 'byin cing / /de bzhin bong bu'i skad dang rta 47—307

yi skad/ /de tshe dom ni seng ge'i skad 'byin kyang / /'jig rten phan mdzad0)ba spu'i khung ma g.yos/ /dred ni nam mkha' lding gi skad 'byin cing / /de tshe de bzhin glang po rta skad 'byin/ /rnam 'dren de ni gtse b.ramu ma nus shing / /bar chad bya ba dag tu'ang ma tshugs so/ /nam mkha' lding ni khu byug skad 'byin cing ske/ /de bzhin ne tso phyugs bzhon57skad 'byin la/ /ne co'i skad ni yang dag skad 'byin byed/ /shang shang te'u'i skad rnams 'byin par byed/ /de tshe ka la ping ku'i yang dag skad/ /de tshe mtshan mo gang la zhe sa'i skad/ /de tshe nyams su dga' ba rma bya'i skad/ /de bzhin tsan tsa'i skad dang shugs kyi skad/ /phyugs bzhin zhe sa'i 47skad dag 'byin par byed/ /de tshe ka la ping ka yid 'ong dga' / /ko ku'i tshig rtsub dag ni 'byin byed kyang / /rgyal ba'i thugs ni gzhan du ma gyur to/ /sbrul ni glang po'i skad dag 'byin byed cing / /de bzhin glang po sbrul gyi skad 'byin kyang / /rnam 'dren de la gtse bar ltam nus shing / /bar chad bya ba dag tu'ang ma tshugs so/ /de tshe ngang pa seng ge'i skad 'byin cing ske/ /de bzhin khyim bya khra yi skad 'byin kyangapo / /rnam 'dren de la gtse b.rashem nus shing na/ /bar chad bya ba dag tu'ang ma tshugs so/ /rta ni dre'u yi skad dag 'byin byed cing / /de bzhin tsan tsa go bo'i skad 'byin kyang / /rnam 'dren de la gtse bar ma nus shing / /bar chad bya ba dag tu'ang ma tshugs so/ /glang po 'ug pa tsan tsa'i skad 'byin cing / /bya dang khyu mchog skad 'byin khrung khrung 9skad/ /de tshe bya rgod 'dzista'i kyi )skad 'byin cing / /bya dang khyu mchog bho ri'i 11skad 'byin la/ /ngang pa'i kha nas skad rnams thams cad 'byin/ /de bzhin khu byug gnod sbyin kun gyi skad/ /de tshe grul bum thams cad skad 'byin 47—308

cing ske/ /de bzhin kha gcig0)nas ni skad kun 'byin/ /kha yi rnam pa de las de skad 'byin/ /skad cig tu ni mtha' yas skad 'byin kyang / /rnam 'dren de la gtser bar ma nus shing / /bar chad byed pa dag tu'ang ma tshugs so/ /klu yi kha nas rdo yi char 'bebs shing / /de bzhin mtshon cha drag po'i char 'bebs kyang //rnam 'dren de la gtse bar ma nus shing / /bar chad byed pa dag tu'ang ma tshugs so / /gnod sbyin kha nas rdo yi char 'bebs shing / /de bzhin me rab 'bar ba'i char 'bebs la/ /de bzhin ri dang phyag dar char 'bebs kyang / /bde gshegs bar chad bya bar ma gi)nus so/ /grul bum mda' yi char dang de bzhin du / /me 'bar dang ni mtshon cha'i char 'bebs kyang / /rnam 'dren de la gtse bar ma nus shing 3)/ /bar chad byed pa dag tu'ang ma tshugs so/ /de tshe bdud ni sdig can de yis su/ /shin tu mi bzad rnam pas 6)gtses byas kyang / /brtson 'grus dpag med stobs ni bskyed nas su/ /bdud stobs sten57 pa byang chub rtogs par chud/ /rang byung gis ni bdud sde spa bkong 87zhing / /ljon mchog drung du skyilashemo dbyer med bcas/ /sbun pa rlung gis phyar ltar 7bcom nas su/ /byang chub mchog reg 31 skye dgu thugs su chud/ /de tshe sa ni rnam drug rab g.yos shing / /bsnyen par dka' 32ba'i sde de phyogs 'tshol 32to/ /rlung gi rgyal pos bya ni khyer ba ltar/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i gzi yis rnam par bcom//klu dang gnod sbyin srin po de dag gis/ /de tshe sna tshogs gdong ni mngon par sprul / /de dag bdud bsten pa yi gzi brjid kyis/ /kha na byed patshang yod pa de dag bcom/ /ji ltar nga yis bdud kyi bu mo bcom/ /bud med 'di dag bdag gis der rgas nasabo/ /de bzhin bdud stobs bsnyen dka' skyarang gis 47—309

sprul / /bdud stobs bsten pa'i mthu yis bcom par gyur37/ /bde gshegs mchog la lha yis bu 3sprul bkang / /'jig rten rnam par 'dren pas zil gyis mnan / /lha yi bu mo khri phrag brgyad cu kun/ /bdud bsten pas ni byang chub dag nal btsud/ /rnam par btul cing byang chub mi g.yo gnas/ /de tshe bsnyen gepar dka' sgrub sdug bsngal gyur/ /de yi tshe na bdud bsten byung nas su/ /'gro ba de dag bdag gis 'grol bar byas/ /de ltar nga yis 7)brtson 'grus bskyed pas su/ /de tshe thub par nadaka' ba'i bdud las rgyal/ /rdul bral zhi mchog byang chub tshol ba na/ /nga yi rje)sras kyis de ltar bslab 7par bya/ /sems can bye ba mang po'i don bya zhing 1 / / nams kyang 1gebadag gi phyir ni bde mi bya/ /ji ltar mgo la me 'bar gzhan mi sems/ /skyes bus zhi nya bya lta bur brtson 'grus bskyed/ /de ltar zhi ba mchog dag tshol 1 ba na15/ /yid kyis yid kyis rnam par bsam par byosal/ /de nas klu'i rgyal po zla ba chen pos bcom ldan 'das la tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs kyis zhu ba zhus pa/ mi dang lha yi ston pa kha lo sgyur/ /lha dang bcas pa 'gro 'di'i 'dren pa ste/ /ji ltar bde gshegs bdag 'khrungs dran ldan pa/ /bla med byang chub thob pa bdag gis zhu/ /'dren pa thub pas 'dir ni srid 1 las rgyal/ /ji ltar 'dren pa bde gshegs bdag la 'khrungs/ /bdud ni rmongs mdzad mya ngan 'das reg pa/ /rgyal ba gang zag mchog gis 1 lung bstan pa/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag la dran bsdams na / /nyes bcas 'khor ba'i 'gro ba 'gag par 'gyur/ /skye bo mi mkhas gang la chags gyur pa/ /bde ba rab tu mi shes sdug bsngal reg /dran pa nyams pa 'khor ba de dang der/ /mi mkhas 19'khor ba'i sdug bsngal rjes su dran/ /47—310
